findings.problem: The regular-presentation API restricts families to `Fin m`, although the underlying bound already supports arbitrary finite index types. This forces users with finite subtypes or other natural labels to reindex their points, hypotheses, event, and product merely to use this wrapper.
findings.proposed_change:
Generalize the statement to:

 theorem RegularSLEPresentation.physical_multipoint_main
    {Ω ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {P : Measure Ω} {κ : ℝ}
    {γ : Ω → ℝ≥0 → ℂ} (a : RegularSLEPresentation P κ γ)
    (hκ : 0 < κ) (hκ8 : κ < 8) (hgrowth : PublishedDiskUnivalentGrowth)
    (J : ℂ → ℂ) (hJ : DifferentiableOn ℂ J upperHalfPlane)
    (hJinj : InjOn J upperHalfPlane) (z : ι → ℂ)
    (hz : ∀ i, z i ∈ upperHalfPlane) (hne : Function.Injective z)
    (b e : ι → ℝ) (hb : ∀ i, 0 < b i) (he : ∀ i, 0 < e i)
    (hbR : ∀ i, b i ≤ 2*(z i).im*‖deriv J (z i)‖)
    (hsep : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → b i ≤ dist (J (z i)) (J (z j))) :
    (P.comap (Subtype.val : a.samples → Ω))
      {ω | ∀ i, ∃ t : ℝ≥0, z i ∈ survivingDomain (γ ω) t ∧
        physicalConformalRadius J (a.G ω) t (z i) ≤ e i} ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (multipointConstant κ (Fintype.card ι) *
        ∏ i, min 1 ((e i/b i)^(1-κ/8)))

Use the existing proof with index type `ι`. To normalize the constant, apply `Multipoint.uniformDiscountBudget_map` to `(Fintype.equivFin ι).toEmbedding` and `Finset.univ`, then simplify with `Finset.map_univ_equiv`. This identifies its budget with the one defining `multipointConstant κ (Fintype.card ι)`. No nonemptiness assumption is needed: the underlying theorem and equivalence also cover empty index types. Retain the current `Fin m` statement as a compatibility specialization if desired.
findings.benefit: Makes the presentation-level theorem directly usable for naturally labelled finite families while keeping the constant dependent only on κ and cardinality. The proof requires only existing reindexing lemmas, not new probability or SLE mathematics.
